ipc_title: Habitual dealing in slaves
bns_title: Habitual dealing in slaves
description: Habitually importing, exporting, removing, buying, selling or dealing in slaves continues as BNS 145, punishable with imprisonment for life or up to ten years and fine.
ai_summary: IPC 371 on habitual dealing in slaves maps directly to BNS 145 with unchanged punishment.

ipc_title: Unlawful compulsory labour
bns_title: Unlawful compulsory labour
description: Unlawfully compelling any person to labour against his will continues as BNS 146, punishable with up to one year or fine or both.
ai_summary: IPC 374 on unlawful compulsory labour maps directly to BNS 146.

ipc_title: Theft in dwelling house, etc.
bns_title: Theft in a dwelling house, or means of transportation or place of worship, etc.
description: Theft in a building used as a dwelling or for custody of property is now BNS 305, which expands the offence to theft in means of transportation and places of worship.
ai_summary: IPC 380 on theft in a dwelling house maps to BNS 305, which widens the offence to vehicles and places of worship.

ipc_title: Mischief by destroying, moving or rendering less useful a light-house or sea-mark
bns_title: Mischief by destroying or moving any sign or signal used for navigation
description: Mischief concerning light-houses and sea-marks is now BNS 326(d), which broadens the provision to any sign or signal used for navigation of rail, aircraft or ship.
ai_summary: IPC 433 on destroying light-houses or sea-marks maps to BNS 326(d), widened to cover rail, aircraft and ship navigation signals.

ipc_title: Mischief by destroying or moving, etc., a landmark fixed by public authority
bns_title: Mischief by destroying or moving a landmark fixed by public authority
description: Mischief by destroying, moving or rendering less useful a landmark fixed by public authority is now clause (e) of the consolidated mischief provision BNS 326.
ai_summary: IPC 434 on destroying or moving public landmarks maps to BNS 326(e).

ipc_title: Mischief with intent to destroy or make unsafe a decked vessel or one of twenty tons burden
bns_title: Mischief with intent to destroy or make unsafe a decked vessel or one of twenty tons burden
description: Mischief intending to destroy or make unsafe a decked vessel or vessel of twenty tons burden is now BNS 327(1), punishable with up to ten years and fine.
ai_summary: IPC 437 on mischief against decked vessels maps to BNS 327(1).

ipc_title: Punishment for the mischief described in section 437 committed by fire or explosive substance
bns_title: Mischief described in sub-section (1) committed by fire or explosive substance
description: The aggravated form of vessel mischief committed by fire or explosive substance is now BNS 327(2), punishable with imprisonment for life or up to ten years and fine.
ai_summary: IPC 438 on vessel mischief by fire or explosives maps to BNS 327(2).

ipc_title: Punishment for intentionally running vessel aground or ashore with intent to commit theft, etc.
bns_title: Punishment for intentionally running vessel aground or ashore with intent to commit theft, etc.
description: Intentionally running a vessel aground or ashore with intent to commit theft or dishonest misappropriation continues as BNS 328, punishable with up to ten years and fine.
ai_summary: IPC 439 on running a vessel aground to commit theft maps directly to BNS 328.

ipc_title: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint
bns_title: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint
description: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking after preparation to cause hurt, assault or wrongful restraint is now BNS 331(5), punishable with up to ten years and fine.
ai_summary: IPC 455 maps to BNS 331(5) within the consolidated lurking house-trespass and house-breaking section.

ipc_title: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint
bns_title: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking after sunset and before sunrise after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint
description: The night-time form after preparation for hurt is now BNS 331(6), which replaces the phrase by night with after sunset and before sunrise and punishes with up to fourteen years.
ai_summary: IPC 458 maps to BNS 331(6), with by night reworded as after sunset and before sunrise.

ipc_title: Trade mark
bns_title: Omitted in BNS
description: IPC 478 defining trade mark was repealed by the Trade and Merchandise Marks Act, 1958 and therefore has no counterpart in the BNS, which retains only property-mark provisions in section 345.
chapter: Offences Relating to Documents and to Property Marks
ai_summary: IPC 478 was already repealed in 1958 and is omitted in the BNS; trade marks are governed by the Trade Marks Act, 1999.

ipc_title: Using a false trade mark
bns_title: Omitted in BNS
description: IPC 480 on using a false trade mark was repealed by the Trade and Merchandise Marks Act, 1958 and has no counterpart in the BNS, which deals only with false property marks in section 345.
chapter: Offences Relating to Documents and to Property Marks
ai_summary: IPC 480 was repealed in 1958 and is omitted in the BNS; false trade mark offences fall under trade marks legislation.

ipc_title: Breach of contract of service during voyage or journey
bns_title: Omitted in BNS
description: IPC 490 on breach of contract of service during a voyage or journey was repealed by the Workmen's Breach of Contract (Repealing) Act, 1925 and has no counterpart in the BNS.
chapter: Criminal Breach of Contracts of Service
ai_summary: IPC 490 was repealed in 1925 and is omitted in the BNS.

ipc_title: Breach of contract to attend on and supply wants of helpless person
bns_title: Breach of contract to attend on and supply wants of helpless person
description: Voluntarily omitting to care for a helpless person whom one is contractually bound to attend continues as BNS 357 with fine enhanced to five thousand rupees.
chapter: Criminal Breach of Contracts of Service
ai_summary: IPC 491 on breach of contract to attend a helpless person maps directly to BNS 357.

ipc_title: Breach of contract to serve at distant place
bns_title: Omitted in BNS
description: IPC 492 on breach of contract to serve at a distant place was repealed by the Workmen's Breach of Contract (Repealing) Act, 1925 and has no counterpart in the BNS.
chapter: Criminal Breach of Contracts of Service
ai_summary: IPC 492 was repealed in 1925 and is omitted in the BNS.

ipc_title: Cohabitation caused by a man deceitfully inducing a belief of lawful marriage
bns_title: Cohabitation caused by man deceitfully inducing belief of lawful marriage
description: A man deceitfully inducing a woman to believe she is lawfully married to him and cohabiting with her in that belief is now BNS 81, punishable with up to ten years and fine.
ai_summary: IPC 493 on cohabitation by deceitful belief of marriage maps directly to BNS 81 in the women and children chapter.

ipc_title: Same offence with concealment of former marriage from person with whom subsequent marriage is contracted
bns_title: Marrying again during lifetime of husband or wife with concealment of former marriage
description: Bigamy committed while concealing the former marriage from the person with whom the subsequent marriage is contracted is now BNS 82(2), punishable with up to ten years and fine.
ai_summary: IPC 495 on bigamy with concealment of the former marriage maps to BNS 82(2).

ipc_title: Marriage ceremony fraudulently gone through without lawful marriage
bns_title: Marriage ceremony fraudulently gone through without lawful marriage
description: Dishonestly or fraudulently going through a marriage ceremony knowing one is not thereby lawfully married continues as BNS 83, punishable with up to seven years and fine.
ai_summary: IPC 496 on fraudulent marriage ceremonies maps directly to BNS 83.

ipc_title: Punishment for defamation
bns_title: Punishment for defamation
description: The punishment for defamation is now BNS 356(2), which adds community service as an alternative to simple imprisonment up to two years or fine or both.
chapter: Criminal Intimidation, Insult, Annoyance, Defamation, Etc.
ai_summary: IPC 500 punishing defamation maps to BNS 356(2), which introduces community service as a new punishment option.

ipc_title: Printing or engraving matter known to be defamatory
bns_title: Printing or engraving matter known to be defamatory
description: Printing or engraving matter known or reasonably believed to be defamatory is now BNS 356(3) within the consolidated defamation section.
chapter: Criminal Intimidation, Insult, Annoyance, Defamation, Etc.
ai_summary: IPC 501 on printing defamatory matter maps to BNS 356(3).

ipc_title: Sale of printed or engraved substance containing defamatory matter
bns_title: Sale of printed or engraved substance containing defamatory matter
description: Selling or offering for sale printed or engraved substance known to contain defamatory matter is now BNS 356(4) within the consolidated defamation section.
chapter: Criminal Intimidation, Insult, Annoyance, Defamation, Etc.
ai_summary: IPC 502 on selling defamatory printed matter maps to BNS 356(4).
